official_task_record.official_task_record_sha256_rule: Lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 of the externally retained parsed task-level official receipt.

attempt_records.ok_record_rule: status OK; candidate/evaluator hashes are lowercase 64-hex; valid_program is integer 0 or 1 (not Boolean); success_rate is an exact nonnegative decimal string in [0,1]; generation_cost_quantity is an exact nonnegative decimal string in the frozen primary metric; billed USD and evaluator billed USD are exact decimal strings or null; failure is null. BILLED_USD primary requires non-null billed USD equal to generation_cost_quantity.
attempt_records.cannot_check_record_rule: status CANNOT_CHECK; failure has exactly status=CANNOT_CHECK, stage, code, detail_sha256; outcomes are null; available hashes/cost quantities/billed costs remain recorded and nulls remain null.
attempt_records.decimal_string_rule: ASCII base-10 only, no sign or exponent, no leading zero except zero itself; finite and nonnegative.

outcome_ledger_contract.missingness_rule: Any unreadable ledger, schema defect, wrong identity, missing/duplicate/extra task or nested attempt, nonparseable value, or CANNOT_CHECK evaluator record makes the complete gate CANNOT_CHECK before any solve metric or bootstrap is computed. Nothing is coerced to solved=0.
outcome_ledger_contract.retention_rule: The committed packet contains no official outcome ledger. Production ledgers, raw evaluator bodies, judge responses, candidate bodies, credentials and benchmark artifacts remain outside ORION.

cost_gate_metric_binding.required_before: candidate generation and any official outcome opening
cost_gate_metric_binding.binding_rule: cost_gate_metric_binding_sha256 is SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON serialized with ensure_ascii=false, keys sorted lexicographically, and separators comma/colon with no whitespace; the object contains strings only. The same digest must be included in the prospectively frozen run plan and candidate seal.

BILLED_USD.per_attempt_quantity: generation_cost_quantity equals generation_billed_cost_usd exactly and billed USD is authoritative, not an imputed zero.

ALLOCATED_ACCELERATOR_SECONDS.per_attempt_quantity: generation_cost_quantity is the prospectively allocated accelerator-seconds for the attempt under the frozen non-overlap rule; billed USD remains separately retained when available.

cost_gate_metric_binding.selection_rule: Exactly one supported metric is frozen before generation/outcomes. Missing, post-outcome-selected, non-authoritative or binding-mismatched metric identity is CANNOT_CHECK; the analyzer never falls back from one metric to the other.

estimands.inference_unit: task, paired across arms; attempts are collapsed within task-arm and are not independent n
estimands.task_solved: For a complete task-arm, 1 iff at least one of its three OK records has valid_program == 1 and exact success_rate == 1; otherwise 0.
estimands.primary_estimand: RR solve rate minus the empirically stronger aggregate comparator solve rate.
estimands.strongest_comparator: The larger aggregate task solve rate among OS and NR; an exact tie selects OS by frozen arm order.

bootstrap.draw_rule: For each replicate and stratum, draw exactly the original stratum size with replacement. One sampled task index is applied to RR, OS and NR together.

rng.initialization: Reference 624-word MT19937 initialization with multiplier 1812433253 and arithmetic modulo 2^32.
rng.uniform_index: Unbiased rejection on uint32: accept x < floor(2^32/n)*n, then x mod n.

interval.name: paired stratified percentile bootstrap
interval.quantile_rule: Nearest-rank empirical quantile: sorted replicate at one-indexed rank ceil(q*B). For B=100000 the lower and upper indices are 2499 and 97499 zero-indexed.
interval.gate_rule: Both RR-OS and RR-NR lower bounds are strictly greater than 0.

discipline_noninferiority.rule: Within every frozen discipline, RR minus OS and RR minus NR solve-rate differences must each be at least -0.05.
discipline_noninferiority.reporting: Publish every discipline task count, all three arm solved counts/rates and both contrasts.

cost_gate.metric_identity: Exactly one prospectively frozen cost_gate_metric: BILLED_USD or ALLOCATED_ACCELERATOR_SECONDS. No post-outcome fallback or substitution.
cost_gate.generation_cost_scope: Sum generation_cost_quantity over all 102 x 3 attempt records for an arm, including failed and outcome-unselected attempts.
cost_gate.ratio: RR primary generation-cost quantity divided by the selected strongest comparator primary generation-cost quantity in the identical frozen unit/allocation rule.
cost_gate.billed_usd_reporting: Retain and report generation_billed_cost_usd separately when authoritative; missing billed USD is never zero. It is gate-primary only when metric_id is BILLED_USD.
cost_gate.official_evaluator_cost: Retain and report official_evaluator_billed_cost_usd separately with availability counts; never include it in the generation-cost ratio.

pass_iff_all: 102 exact parseable official task records and 918 exact nested attempt records
all 8 discipline x comparator noninferiority contrasts >= -0.05
RR primary generation-cost ratio to strongest comparator <= 1.5 under the identical prospectively frozen metric identity and allocation rule

result_contract.cannot_check_rule: When gate_evaluable is false, estimands and gate metrics are null and typed reasons are retained.
result_contract.rounding: Rates and bootstrap bounds are emitted to 12 decimal places for display; gate comparisons use exact Fractions or Decimals before display rounding.

forbidden: changing the RNG, seed, replicate count, interval rank rule or task strata after any official outcome is opened
selecting only successful or cheapest attempts for generation cost
selecting the comparator after considering cost or CI rather than aggregate solve rate
coercing missing, invalid, runtime-failed or evaluator-failed outcomes to solved=0
falling back between billed USD and accelerator-seconds after outcomes, or treating missing billed USD as zero
treating a synthetic validation pass as benchmark evidence, protected custody, independence or scientific promotion
